name: Livroop Gill
bio: Liv leads DBAS with a vision to help build a safe, supportive space where students can bridge the gap between university and professional life while having fun.

name: Saamarth Nagpal
bio: As Vice President of DBAS, Saamarth aims to create a welcoming space where students can network, ask questions freely, and ease into the technical side of analytics.

name: Quynh Hoang
bio: As the Secretary, Quynh aims to create a small discussion group where members can explore how Business Analytics is applied across different cultures, highlighting how local markets and cultural differences shape data‑driven decisions within DBAS.

name: Senuri Shenara Fernando
bio: Through her role with DBAS, Sheni aims to strengthen her analytical skills, gain practical experience, and understand how data-driven insights are applied in real-world decision-making.

name: Norint Ek
bio: In the role of Director of Marketing for DBAS, Norint focuses on strengthening the society’s brand and engagement through data‑informed strategy.

name: Rishita Sharma
bio: In DBAS, Rishita aims to expand the Business & Consulting division by building industry‑focused initiatives, strengthening partnerships, and creating hands‑on consulting and analytics opportunities for members.

name: Rudransh Sharma
bio: As the Director of Planning and Events at DBAS, Rudransh focuses on delivering well‑structured, efficient, and sustainable events.

name: Van Nguyen
bio: As a part of the AI Committee, Van seeks to explore how AI and digital tools can streamline DBAS's operations, turning manual processes into more efficient workflows for the committees.
